content:
When acknowledging an email, it is important to be prompt, courteous, and professional. Here is a simple template you can use to respond to an email:

Subject: Re: [original subject of the email]

Dear [Recipient's Name],

Thank you for your email. I wanted to acknowledge receipt and confirm that I have read it. I will take the necessary steps to address any issues mentioned and will follow up with you as needed.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me.

Thank you again for contacting me.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
